The following events took place in '''738 BBY'''.

==Events==
*The [[Mandalorian Excision]]: [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] troops, led by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], engage the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] in [[Mandalore sector/Legends|their home sector]], bringing devastation to [[Mandalore/Legends|their world]] and spurring the creation of the pacifistic [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] movement.
